body:
Merged `main` after #4458 merged. Ready for a re-check.

- The merge of `origin/main` had no conflict and no hand edit. New head: `090d3c74db5d042ee78deb138db36a1ddfb1b1f8`.
- Quick gate on that head (winbuild lane, `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`): 15 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. The step "site tests" is SKIPPED (the tools are not on the lane). This is not a pass.
- `cargo check -p camcraft-ui` and `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-ui-kit --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `#[test]` count of `crates/ui` + `crates/ui-kit`: 2026 on `main`, 2036 on the merged head.
- The PR body no longer has the "Stacked on #4458" line. The gate section names the new head.
- The PR stays a draft.

Quick pass: good. Head `090d3c7` merges cleanly with `main` (the parent #4458 merged). On this head, the quick gate (15 steps, 0 failed) and clippy of `camcraft-ui` and `camcraft-ui-kit` are green. The site-tests step was skipped on the Windows lane, but the diff touches no input of the site tests. The `crates/ui` + `crates/ui-kit` test count goes from 2026 to 2036. An independent pre-review found no blocking points. I flag the PR ready for review.

**Verdict: ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers. This is a `feat` PR, so it merges at the next cut.

Reviewer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4466#issuecomment-7231222835

## Scope

The change is display only. It changes the 3D preview in the tool library, the Properties side preview and three theme tokens. No toolpath, collision check, simulation or post reads `flutes`, `thread_form`, `model::parts` or the new inks. The collision and body meshes (`tool_body_view`, `Tool::geom`) do not change. This is not a safety-tier review.

## Where it ran

Locally (macOS, Apple M5 Max GPU), in a worktree. The PR head `090d3c7` already contains upstream/main `2394b5ad1`, so the trial merge was "Already up to date".

## Results

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 15 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
  - ui-kit build, lib, contrast, gallery: ok.
  - ui build, lib, boundary, boundary_picks, contour_dxf_sketch, sinker_setup, tap_hand, theme_example, theme_files, waterjet_tool: ok.
  - site tests: ok (132 tests). This host has python, zola and node, so the step ran. It was skipped on the author's lane.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-ui-kit --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Pinning tests (`tool_library_dialog` filter of the ui lib): 31 passed, 0 failed.

Extra suites run: none were needed. The diff changes no `testdata/`, no importer, no post, no operation, no motion code and no catalog. The example catalog suites and the light lane do not reach this diff.

## Mutations (local, reverted)

1. Remove `ToolKind::Keyseat` from `flutes::fluted_kind`. Result: red. `each_fluted_kind_shows_its_flutes`, `each_fluted_kind_has_a_flute_mesh_in_the_preview` and `the_fluted_steel_keeps_to_its_facet_bound` fail.
2. In `model::parts_of`, change the cutting-part limit from `flute_len` to `flute_len * 0.5`. Result: red. `each_facet_carries_its_part` fails.

After the revert, the 31 tests pass again and the tree is clean.

## What looks good

- `model.rs` computes `parts` from the steel mesh before the holder facets are added. The bare mesh is the steel prefix, so `shown()` gives the correct parts for each Holder and Flutes toggle state. `each_facet_carries_its_part` pins this with `Arc::ptr_eq`.
- `project_with` enumerates before `step_by`, so the part index stays correct when the painted budget thins the mesh. A missing part falls back to `Holder`, so there is no index panic.
- `shade()` clamps the light and reads a NaN light as 0.3. The `as u8` casts are clamped first. There is no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside the tests.
- Frame cost: `ProjKey` adds the parts `Arc` and the inks. The existing still-frame counter tests in `egui_app/tests/tool_library_preview.rs` stay green. `a_part_ink_change_is_a_new_projection_key` is the changed-input test.
- The three inks are complete in the theme struct, both tables, `legal.rs`, `names.rs`, the overlay, the gallery rows, `theme.json.example` and `docs/user-guide/themes.md`. `the_3d_preview_parts_have_three_theme_inks` checks the contrast on `tool_ground`. There is no colour literal in `crates/ui`.
- The display defaults (a drill without a count draws 2 flutes at 30 degrees, a tap draws 3) do not write to the tool. `a_drill_and_a_tap_without_a_count_draw_their_kinds_flutes` pins them. A stated count still wins.
- Laws:
  - All touched source files are under 400 lines.
  - No snapshot PNG changed.
  - No process file, dependency, `build.rs`, `scripts/` or `.github/` change.
  - The decision record is `docs/decisions/4452-preview-flutes-colours.md`.
  - The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #4452`. The fixing commit `666a46957` also ends with `Fixes #4452`.
  - The commit subjects follow the Conventional Commits format.
  - The `crates/ui` + `crates/ui-kit` `#[test]` count goes up (2026 to 2036).
- Screenshots: the body has before and after images for five tools in the dark and light themes. All 20 files are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch under `4466/`.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

- `mod.rs` changes `thread_form` from private to `pub(crate)`. The old comment said that a private module meant "no law can read it". The module is still in `crates/ui`, so no law crate can import it. The new comment says this. No change is necessary.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
